test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

She asked whether, in view of the delays caused by external vendors, the timeline for delivery could be reconsidered.

options.text: “Could the delivery timeline be reconsidered because of the delays by external vendors?” she asked.
“Given the vendor delays, can you review the delivery schedule?” she asked.
“Would it be possible to reconsider the timeline due to the external delays?” she asked.
“Is there any chance the delivery deadline can be extended due to the vendor delays?” she asked.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She asked whether, in view of the delays caused by external vendors, the timeline for delivery could be reconsidered.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"whether... could be reconsidered" becomes "Could... be reconsidered?"**
 
 
• The conjunction **"whether"** indicates that the original direct speech was a Yes/No question.
